headline: Bids for Tidewater Landing Riverwalk East, Library Roof Drain Replacement, and the 2027 City Calendar, plus a Morley Field services award.
summary: The agenda lists bid openings for three items, including the 2027 City of Pawtucket Calendar. It also lists a Morley Field services award recommendation and two HVAC items.
items: Bid opening: 26-024 Library Roof Drain Replacement (rebid)
Bid opening: 26-034 2027 City of Pawtucket Calendar
Bid opening: 27-003 Tidewater Landing Phase 1B Riverwalk East Contract 1, Advance Work
Award recommendation for RFQ 26-020, Environmental, Engineering & Design Services for Morley Field, to Fuss & O'Neill
Senior Center Roof Top HVAC Replacement, MPA procurement, Arden
Mechanical Engineering Services for installing new HVAC system at Fire Stations # 3 & #6: approval of issuing RFP
location: Room 204, Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street
